list.title: Access
list.subtitle: Applications your team grants access to — who can reach what.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.description: Add the SaaS products, systems and services your team grants access to — then track who can reach each one.

form.cloneSubtitle: A new application pre-filled from this one. Review it, then grant access separately.
form.vendorHelp: Who makes the software — not who you buy it from (that is a supplier).
form.urlDescription: Scheme-less hosts and http(s) only; other schemes are rejected.
form.criticalDescription: Access here is especially sensitive (production infra, finance) and is highlighted in listings.
form.licenseDescription: Optional license tracking. Record how many seats you pay for, the price per seat, and when the license renews. Seats in use are counted automatically from active grants.
form.seatsPurchasedHelp: Number of paid seats. Leave blank to not track a limit.
form.costPerSeatHelp: Price of a single seat, per billing period.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted, or the API is unreachable.

critical.note: Critical application. The AI assistant changes its access or automation only in the lazyit chat, after you confirm your password; Claude Code and other MCP clients are refused.
critical.automation: This application is critical. Its workflows work as usual here; the AI assistant can change them only in the lazyit chat, after you confirm your password.

attention.label: Needs attention
attention.expiredGrants: {count, plural, one {# grant has expired and will be revoked shortly} other {# grants have expired and will be revoked shortly}}
attention.expiringGrants: {count, plural, one {# grant expires} other {# grants expire}} in the next {days} days
attention.overAllocated: {count, plural, one {# person over the purchased seats} other {# people over the purchased seats}}
attention.renewalSoon: License renews in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
attention.renewalPassed: {count, plural, =0 {License renewal date is today} one {License renewal date passed # day ago} other {License renewal date passed # days ago}}
attention.deactivatedHolders: {count, plural, one {# deactivated person still holds access} other {# deactivated people still hold access}}
attention.pendingRequests: {count, plural, one {# access request waiting for a decision} other {# access requests waiting for a decision}}

facts.grants: {count, plural, =0 {No active grants} one {# active grant} other {# active grants}}
facts.grantsAttention: {count, plural, one {# active grant} other {# active grants}} · {expiring} expiring
facts.seatsFree: {count, plural, =0 {No seats free} one {# seat free} other {# seats free}}
facts.seatsOver: {count, plural, one {Over by # seat} other {Over by # seats}}
facts.renewalPassed: {count, plural, =0 {today} one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

access.title: Access
access.emptyDescription: Grant access to record who can reach this application.
access.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: No one holds access to this application yet.

emptyStatus.active: No active grants. Everyone who had access has been revoked.
emptyStatus.expiring: Nothing expires in the next 30 days.
emptyStatus.revoked: No grant has been revoked yet.

empty.PENDING: No requests waiting for a decision.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: No access has been granted or revoked yet.

about.title: About
about.noLicense: No license details recorded. Add seats, a cost per seat or a renewal date from Edit.

access.grantDescription: Give a user access to this application. A user may hold several grants at different access levels.
access.accessLevelDescription: Optional, free-form — pick a common value or type whatever this application calls its roles.
access.expiresDescription: Optional — once it passes, the grant is revoked automatically.
access.notesPlaceholder: Optional — e.g. requested for the Q3 migration
access.editDescriptionPrefix: Update the expiry and notes for
access.editDescriptionSuffix: . The grant itself is unchanged — to change the access level, revoke and grant again.
access.editExpiresDescription: Optional — once it passes, the grant is revoked automatically. Clear it to make the grant permanent.
access.editNotesDescription: Leave empty to clear the note.
access.expiryBeforeGranted: The expiry can't be earlier than when the access was granted. Pick a later date.
access.revokeDescriptionSuffix: . The grant is kept in history — revoking ends it, it is not a deletion.

avatars.deactivatedTooltip: {count, plural, one {# deactivated grantee} other {# deactivated grantees}}

request.title: Request access
request.description: Ask an administrator for access to this application. They'll be notified and can approve or deny your request.
request.accessLevelDescription: Optional — the level of access you need (each application defines its own).
request.justificationDescription: Optional — a short note to help the approver decide.
request.alreadyPending: You already have a pending request for this application.
request.error: Couldn't send your request. Please try again.

requests.title: Access requests
requests.subtitle: Review who's asking for access — approve to grant it, or deny with a reason.
requests.lockedDescription: You don't have permission to see the access-request queue. Ask an administrator if you need it.
requests.emptyDescription: There's nothing waiting for a decision right now.
requests.decideError: Couldn't complete that action. Please try again.
requests.denyDescription: Deny {name}'s request for access. They'll see your reason on their profile.
requests.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you denying this request?
requests.reasonRequired: A reason is required to deny a request.
